parameters: Sister Diana! I hope we meet your expectations!\! And we have more than enough supplies to make it safely home.
Of course, Abigayle. Thank you, Sister. You are to serve our new friend, \n[8], during our journey.
So pleased to meet you, \n[8]! Yes, I am a priestess of the Sisterhood of Mercy.
...You look so familiar. Do you have a brother?
Ha, yep. You're a mirror image of my friend, Jules. Only a sibling of his could be so... sunny.
!!!\| You know my brother?! Wow, how fortuitous!\! If you are a friend of my brother, you are surely a friend of mine, dear \n[8]. If... you will have me, of course...
